summary: Preserve global platform group authority during native tenant ownership upgrades and keep single-tenant setup links routable.
userImpact: Reserved platform administrator groups and their memberships retain global ownership when migration 125 runs.
Single-tenant setup opens platform settings; legacy /admin/tenants links redirect to settings instead of a missing route, and completed setup no longer retains an earlier setup redirect.

instructions: Run the normal owner migration process to apply RestorePlatformGroupOwnership1700000000135 before starting the upgraded application.
Pooled PostgreSQL uses a new signed schema-epoch manifest through 0135. Coordinate the application cutover with the owner migration; older runtimes bounded to 0134 do not accept the new ledger.

configuration: EG_TENANCY_MODE=single continues to permit only the default tenant; pooled tenant lifecycle behavior is unchanged.

notes: Migration 125 excludes reserved platform group IDs and their memberships from the default-tenant backfill.

Migration 135 restores default-tenant system-group rows with reserved IDs and canonical provenance, and only memberships emitted by the global administrator and authenticated-user baseline services. It does not create memberships, change expiry or sources, modify users, or move ordinary tenant groups.

security: Platform authorization remains permission-backed and independent of user tenant ownership or the legacy platformRole label.
Tenant administrator assignments do not grant platform tenant lifecycle authority; expired and removed memberships remain ineffective.
documentation: Technical release notes describe the bounded ownership repair and single-tenant setup routing.

customerDocumentation.reason: Restores existing administration behavior; migration and rollback details are included in the technical release notes.

knownLimitations: Memberships without canonical global-service provenance remain tenant-scoped and require an audited administrator regrant after reviewing their origin.
The OSS v0.32.0 and v0.32.1 user entity has no tenant_id column and migration 125 excludes users; a deployment reporting that column requires exact image and schema verification.
rollback: Migration 135 is a forward ownership repair; its down method deliberately preserves the repaired global rows.
Pooled PostgreSQL runtimes bounded to epoch 0134 reject the 0135 ledger. Coordinate any downgrade through approved schema-epoch recovery; application rollback alone does not undo migration 135.
validation: Backend unit gate: 485 files and 4,095 tests passed; the final ownership regression module passes six cases, including bootstrap and legacy administrator provenance.
Frontend unit gate: 350 files and 2,427 tests passed on the final product source.
Authorization structure, 146 authorization decision checks, 28 PostgreSQL RLS/identity integration checks, and 84 database portability unit checks passed.

PostgreSQL 18.6, MySQL 8.4.13, SQL Server 16.0.4305.5, Oracle 21, and the Spanner 1.5.30 emulator passed clean-install, upgrade, retry, ownership repair and service checks with equivalent logical schemas.
Native Chromium, Firefox and WebKit passed 63 accessibility, three responsive-layout and 12 setup-routing cases.
Typechecks, changed-file lint, Helm checks, schema-epoch and release-receipt contracts, release-note preflight, documentation boundary and package-version discipline passed.
Local verification evidence is retained outside the source repository. Protected CI and exact signed candidate qualification remain required before publication.

The setup browser regressions carry the protected Access Control CI tag and are included in the scoped local browser runner. All 36 test-lane contract checks pass, and Playwright confirms the filtered lane selects the four setup regressions plus the existing layout test.
